title: Chapter 213 The Declining Xiao Clan
content:
Chapter 213 The Declining Xiao Clan

Seeing the old man, a hint of fear suddenly appeared in the eyes of the three people in the void.

"Senior Xiao Sheng, I didn't expect that you are still alive."

The great elder of the Ye clan chuckled.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Sheng snorted coldly, "As long as I am still alive, you don't want to do anything wrong to me, Xiao clan."

"Now, I'll give you three breaths, get out!"

boom!

A terrifying aura surged out from Xiao Sheng's body again, and for a moment, the three people in the void suddenly looked ugly.

"Hmph, wait, your Xiao clan won't be able to get better for long."

After saying this harsh words, the great elder of the Ye clan left first.

Seeing this, the other two said nothing and followed him.

Obviously, these three families have colluded together, and the purpose is to plan the current Xiao clan.

After the three of them left, the Xiao clan members immediately surrounded Xiao Sheng.

"Senior Xiao Sheng, aren't you in seclusion? Why did you suddenly come out of seclusion?"

Xiao Jing looked at Xiao Sheng, who was drooping in front of him, with a hint of worry in his eyes.

Hearing this, Xiao Sheng smiled bitterly and said slowly, "There is no need to close this level."

"I've had no more time."

The next moment, a faint trace of death energy slowly overflowed from Xiao Sheng's body.

Although it is just a trace, it is real.

Only those who are about to die will emit death.

Buzz —

Suddenly, Xiao Jing was stunned, unable to believe his ears.

The same was true for the other Xiao clan present.

It’s a pity that this trace of death is real.

For a moment, Xiao Jing and other senior leaders of the Xiao clan had their eyes red and they were a little at a loss.

At this time, Xiao Sheng sighed and then slowly walked to Lu Daosheng.

"Fellow Taoist, I have learned everything that happened. This is the fault of my Xiao clan."

Xiao Sheng bowed to Lu Daosheng to express his apology.

Looking at Xiao Sheng in front of him, Lu Daosheng was a little surprised.

Unexpectedly, there is such a wise and powerful existence in the Xiao clan.

If the old man in front of him had not had much time, he would probably not have fallen into danger of extermination even without the help of his Huangcheng City.

"It's over."

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and responded to Xiao Sheng.

Hearing this, Xiao Sheng nodded, then turned around and looked at the hazy mountain in front of him.

"Is it my turn finally?"

Xiao Sheng's eyes gradually lost his mind and he walked slowly towards the mountain in front of him.

Seeing this scene, everyone in the Xiao clan was shocked.

"Senior! Don't!!"

"Senior, once you go in, you can never get out again."

The Xiao clan members held Xiao Sheng tightly and prevented Xiao Sheng from entering the mountains.

Including Xiao Jing and other elders.

However, Xiao Sheng was a little persistent, "Walking into the ancestral land after his death has been the honor of my Xiao clan since ancient times. Why? I have devoted my life to the Xiao clan. Do you want me to die outside?"

Xiao Sheng changed his normalcy and angrily scolded the Xiao people around him.

Suddenly, the Xiao clan members lowered their heads one after another, like a child who made a mistake and did not dare to respond.

Seeing this, Xiao Sheng snorted coldly and said, "Anyway, I am a dying person. Even if I die, I will die in my ancestral land."

Immediately, Xiao Sheng resolutely headed towards the mountains.

At this time, the Xiao clan behind him was already filled with tears.

After Xiao Sheng left, their Xiao clan really had no support.

Could it be that God is going to destroy my Xiao clan?

Just then, a sound rang out.

"Old sir, I'll accompany you for a walk."

Everyone looked in the voice and saw what Lu Daosheng, who had been silent all the time, said.

Xiao Sheng also looked back at Lu Daosheng with some surprise.

"Fellow Taoist, I know you are not ordinary, but my Xiao clan's ancestral land is not an ordinary place. Do you really have to risk your whole life not being able to get out with me?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng laughed.

"In my daughter's words, what's the point?"

"Besides, my daughter is inside."

Indeed, Lu Xue is still inside, and it is reasonable for Lu Daosheng to worry about his daughter.

After a moment of silence, Xiao Sheng nodded.

Why not do it if you have a companion who walks together?

After all, the current ancestral land is not the ancestral land of that year.

In the past tens of millions of years, who knows what the ancestral land has become today?

Seeing Xiao Sheng nodded in agreement.

The Xiao clan members immediately made way for a path.

Without hesitation, Lu Daosheng strode forward and walked to Xiao Sheng's side.

"Let's go."

Xiao Sheng took a deep breath, and finally glanced at the Xiao clan in front of him with affectionate eyes, and a drop of tears slowly fell from the corners of his eyes.

"In the next life, I will be a member of the Xiao clan."

Immediately, Xiao Sheng turned around and headed towards the Xiao clan's ancestral mountain with a firm expression.

Lu Daosheng also followed closely.

At this moment, a deafening roar came from behind.

"We wait, I'll send you off Senior Xiao Sheng!!"

The eyes of the Xiao clan members were red. Since then, although this scene has been seen more than once in the past tens of millions of years, this time it has made the Xiao clan members the most sad.

"What should I do next?"

Xiao Xuanmu sighed, and he had no confidence in the future of the Xiao clan.

Hearing this, Xiao Jing was silent.

As the great elder of the Xiao clan, he had no choice at this moment.

At this time, Xiao Chen suddenly said, "You forgot that Lord Huang City has also entered?"

As soon as these words came out, the two of them were stunned.

"What you mean is that can the Lord of Huang City solve the problem of my Xiao clan's ancestral mountain?"

Xiao Chen was silent for a moment and nodded slightly.

"I believe in the Lord of the Huang City."

After all, from the beginning, they planned to ask the Lord of Huang City to help them solve their Xiao clan’s problems.

Although some small episodes appeared in the middle, the daughter of the Lord of Huang City took the lead in their Xiao clan.

But the result is right.

Moreover, before Lu Xue entered, Xiao Chen and the others believed in Lu Xue's ability, not to mention Lu Xue's biological father, Lu Daosheng, the unfathomable lord of the wasteland city.

Xiao Jing and Xiao Xuanmu looked at each other and nodded immediately.

"Now, there is nothing else to do except believe in their father and daughter."

Their Xiao clan is now really without a leader.

The patron lord of the Xiao clan has entered, and the senior Xiao Sheng has entered now.

Now, they are the only ones left in the Xiao clan.

Finally, the few people sighed, then sat down cross-legged, waiting for the return of Lu Daosheng's father and daughter.

At the same time, the other three major families became lively.

"Class Chief, I have confirmed that the Xiao clan’s deadline is approaching, and our opportunity is here."

The elder of the Ye clan said excitedly.

Although he was a little timid in the face of Xiao Sheng, he was not alone. Behind him, there was the entire Ye clan.

Their Ye tribe is not the Xiao tribe today, and has declined to that level.

On the contrary, their Ye clan is very strong, and there are three Ye clans at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

As long as the other two clans each produce a peak strongman at the Immortal Emperor Realm, he will have the confidence to take down the entire Xiao clan.

But the Ye tribe leader was a little hesitant.

As the patriarch of the ancient family, he knew very well how powerful an ancient force was.

Even if the Xiao clan declines, it will not be so weak.

I'm afraid it's not a fraud.
